dedupe_keys.name: med iren climate proofing mediterranean critical infrastructure with nature based solutions horizon europe 2024 to 2028

description: Med-IREN is a Horizon Europe project that aims to show how nature-based solutions can climate-proof critical infrastructure across the Mediterranean, covering energy, transport, water, communications and social services. It runs from 1 October 2024 to 30 September 2028 with a total cost of about 11.5 million euros, of which about 10.4 million is EU funding. Interventions are demonstrated in five lighthouse regions, each tied to a present-day hazard challenge, and successful ones will be replicated in four more regions across the EU; enabling work covers participatory governance, citizen engagement, financing and urban planning. Coverage is the Mediterranean climate hotspot. Format and access: the project website and the CORDIS fact sheet, free to read; no data or deliverables were found on the pages read. Licence: not read. Caveats: the project is in progress, so outcomes are plans, not results. It supports climate adaptation and resilience studies of multi-sector infrastructure combined with nature-based solutions. A related catalogue record is the Lower Danube Green Corridor floodplain restoration case.
